subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use the past simple and past continuous to tell a story.
Make my writing stronger with strong adjectives like hilarious and huge.
Plan and write a story of about 100 words.

tf.s: In a story, we use the past simple for the main events.
tf.why: Main events are short finished actions.

tf.s: We use the past continuous for background actions in a story.
tf.why: Like 'We were waiting outside the hall.'
With strong adjectives we use 'absolutely': absolutely fantastic.
Hilarious is a strong adjective for funny.

tf.s: The given first sentence must come at the beginning of your story.
tf.why: Start your story with the sentence in the task.

tf.s: A good story has a clear ending.
tf.why: The ending helps the reader enjoy the story.

boxes.q: Replace 'very bad to eat' with a strong adjective.
boxes.why: Disgusting means very bad to eat.

boxes.q: Replace 'very angry' with a strong adjective.
Complete: While she ___, I picked up my laptop.
boxes.why: A longer past action in progress takes the past continuous.

boxes.q: Which word goes with strong adjectives like 'fantastic'?
Replace 'really big' with a strong adjective.
Complete the post: ___ out my new video!
boxes.why: 'Check out' means look at something interesting.

boxes.q: Which plan question is about the place?
Replace 'very good to eat' with a strong adjective.
boxes.why: Delicious means very good to eat.

boxes.q: How long should your story be?
boxes.why: The task asks for about 100 words.

boxes.q: Which tense shows a longer action in progress in the past?
boxes.why: was/were + -ing shows an action in progress.

mcq.q: Which questions help you plan a story?
o: When, where, who, what and the ending
mcq.why: These five questions give your story a clear plan.

mcq.q: Which word can go with both ordinary and strong adjectives?
mcq.why: 'Really good' and 'really fantastic' are both correct.

mcq.q: Which word is a strong adjective?
Complete: We ___ for the bus when it started to rain.
mcq.why: The waiting was in progress when the rain started.

mcq.q: Improve this sentence: 'The beach was really big and the food was very good.'
o: The beach was huge and the food was delicious.
The beach was tiny and the food was disgusting.
The beach was very huge and the food was very delicious.
The beach was big and the food was good.
mcq.why: Strong adjectives make writing more interesting.

mcq.q: Correct this sentence: 'It was very fantastic!'
Why does the story use 'were waiting' and not 'waited'?
o: It is a longer background action in progress when something happened.
It is a short finished action.
mcq.why: The past continuous sets the background.

mcq.q: What makes a story more interesting for the reader?
o: Strong adjectives, a clear order of events and a good ending
Writing it all in the future tense
mcq.why: Good stories are clear and colourful.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to check a partner's story?
o: To suggest ways to improve adjectives and tenses
To make it under ten words
